decision.primary_concern: Offer is below the p25 market floor for the role/level/geo, and there is no internal peer data to validate equity, leaving the number unsupported by either external or internal benchmarks.
decision.reasoning: Converting the 15,000,000 INR offer to USD (~$171,630) and comparing it to the directly-matched market survey for engineering L5 in US-SJC (p25≈$181,904, p50≈$216,552, p75≈$255,532) shows the offer falls below the p25 floor, with a compa-ratio of ~0.79 against the p50 midpoint and negative range penetration (~-14%). It would take roughly $10,274 more just to reach the p25 floor. Additionally, the internal equity check returned zero incumbents in this exact job/geo slice, so there is no internal peer data to support or further justify the number.
